{{Quote|This is Two&mdash;Axe. Ready when you are, skipper.|Axe, checking in with Ahsoka Tano|audio=ThisIsTwoAxe-SOR.flac|<ref name="sor" />}}
'''Axe''' was a veteran [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] who served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Galactic Republic Navy]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] served in [[Blue Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Blue Squadron]], a Republic [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] attached to the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']], and was given the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] "[[Blue Leader/Legends|Blue Leader]]." However, Axe gave the title to [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] when the two participated in the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]], and then took the call sign of "[[Blue Two/Legends|Blue Two]]." In the engagement, Blue Squadron was tasked with destroying the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mar Tuuk/Legends|Mar Tuuk's]] [[Ryloth blockade/Legends|blockade]] over the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].

During the battle, Axe flew a [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]] and was accompanied by fellow clone pilots [[Slammer/Legends|Slammer]], [[Kickback/Legends|Kickback]], [[Tucker/Legends|Tucker]] and [[Swoop (clone trooper)/Legends|Swoop]], while the squadron made its way toward Tuuk's [[Procurer|command ship]]. However, numerous Confederate [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]] attacked Blue Squadron, causing heavy casualties. As the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] had also simultaneously attacked the Republic force's three ''Venator''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]]&mdash;the ''Resolute'', [[Defender/Legends|''Defender'']], and [[Redeemer/Legends|''Redeemer'']]&mdash;[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] and Skywalker ordered Tano and her men to retreat. However, as Blue Squadron made its way toward the ''Resolute''{{'s}} [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], Axe was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when his fighter was shot down by a Vulture droid.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Come on, you whiners. Let's get dirty!|Axe, during the Battle of Ryloth|audio=LetsGetDirty-StormOverRyloth.flac|<ref name="sor" />}}
[[File:AxeRyloth.png|thumb|left|250px|Axe, in his V-19 Torrent starfighter]]
"Axe,"<ref name="sor" /> a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="databank" /> was the nickname of a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] who served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]].<ref name="sor" /> Axe served within [[Blue Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Blue Squadron]], a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in the Republic [[Navy/Legends|Navy]]<ref name="sor" /> that was stationed on board [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]], the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']].<ref name="tcwce" /> During his [[Time/Legends|time]] in Blue Squadron, the clone [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] was given the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] "[[Blue Leader/Legends|Blue Leader]]."<ref name="S1 Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]''</ref>

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]], [[Emir/Legends|Emir]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]], [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|seized]] control of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] and its [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] inhabitants, and so the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] dispatched Skywalker and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], to destroy the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Ryloth blockade/Legends|blockade]] surrounding the planet. On board the ''Resolute'', Blue Squadron was assigned to destroy the enemy blockade. For the mission, Tano was given the task of leading the squadron.<ref name="sor" /> Despite the fact that it was Tano's first time leading a squadron,<ref name="TCWTVG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> Axe gave her the title of "Blue Leader," while he himself took the call sign "[[Blue Two/Legends|Blue Two]]."<ref name="S1 Guide" />

Under the command of Tano, who led the squadron in [[Ahsoka's Delta-7B Jedi Starfighter/Legends|her Jedi starfighter]], Axe was accompanied by fellow Blue Squadron pilots [[Slammer/Legends|Slammer]], [[Kickback/Legends|Kickback]], [[Tucker/Legends|Tucker]] and [[Swoop (clone trooper)/Legends|Swoop]], who flew in [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]]. Tano contacted her pilots, and after Axe and the other Blue Squadron pilots checked in with the Padawan, the group left the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] of the ''Resolute''. As the squadron headed toward the [[Blockade/Legends|blockade's]] [[Procurer|leading command ship]], led by the Confederate [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mar Tuuk/Legends|Mar Tuuk]], Axe and the other pilots were quickly confronted by a tier of [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]].<ref name="sor" /> After Tano split her squadron into two groups,<ref name="sor guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode019.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Storm Over Ryloth}}</ref> Axe and five other pilots separated from her group and were ordered to attack the [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]], while Tano's group engaged the Vulture [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="sor" /> En route toward Tuuk's command [[Starship/Legends|ship]], Axe's group cut open a clear path to the battleship.<ref name="sor guide" />

However, four [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class frigates]] joined Tuuk's blockade,<ref name="sor guide" /> neutralizing Blue Squadron's attack run. Noticing this, Skywalker and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]], who were on board the ''Resolute'', ordered Blue Squadron to fall back and protect the flagship, as it and its accompanying ''Venator''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]]&mdash;the [[Defender/Legends|''Defender'']] and [[Redeemer/Legends|''Redeemer'']]&mdash;were outnumbered. Tano, however, disobeyed the direct order and followed through with her attack on the leading [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] of the blockade. As more Vulture droids attacked the group, Axe and the other pilots took heavy [[Laser/Legends|fire]] from the droids. Soon, Tucker was shot down by a droid, and Axe's fighter was hit near one of its wings. When a group of Vulture droids attacked the three Star Destroyers, Yularen and Skywalker again warned Tano to retreat, as the Republic forces had been caught in a trap.<ref name="sor" />

[[File:Axe_Death.png|thumb|right|250px|Axe dies as his V-19 explodes around him.]]
Tano obeyed and turned back toward the ''Resolute'', as more Vulture droids attacked the three Republic ''Venator''-class Star Destroyers. The outnumbered Blue Squadron headed toward the hangar of the ''Resolute''. When a Vulture droid crashed into the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of the ''Resolute'', Skywalker ordered an immediate jump into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. Hearing of Skywalker's retreat over her starfighter's [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] system, Tano warned Axe and the remaining pilots. However, as Axe tried to keep up with Tano, his starfighter was heavily attacked from behind. Tano tried to help her second-in-command, but it was too late. Axe's fighter malfunctioned and overloaded before he could make it back, and the cockpit exploded. He then [[Death/Legends|perished]] above Ryloth. Aside from Tano, only two out of the original ten clone pilots from Blue Squadron managed to return to the ''Resolute''.<ref name="sor" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Don't worry about me, skipper.|Axe, to Blue Squadron leader Ahsoka Tano|audio=DontWorryAboutMeSkipper-StormOverRyloth.flac|<ref name="sor" />}}
An expert veteran fighter pilot<ref name="tcwce" /> and a strong leader, Axe was a capable pilot<ref name="S1 Guide" /> who served in the Republic Navy's Blue Squadron<ref name="sor" /> as "Blue Leader."<ref name="S1 Guide" /> Axe was not afraid to question his superiors during a mission and showed pride within his squadron.<ref name="sor" /> Prior to the Battle of Ryloth, Axe gave the title of "Blue Leader" to Ahsoka Tano,<ref name="S1 Guide" /> while he took the title of "Blue Two." He befriended her and obeyed the orders she gave to him.<ref name="sor" /> During the attack on Tuuk's command ship, Axe knew that Tano had made a mistake when she failed to cooperate with Skywalker's and Yularen's order of retreating and continued her attack run toward the command ship. Axe, however, remained loyal to his squadron leader, a choice that would cost him his life.<ref name="tcwce" />

While clone troopers of Jango Fett stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]],<ref name="height" /> Axe, a clone of Fett himself, was 2.08 meters tall.<ref name="tcwce" />

==Equipment==
Axe's [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] was sleek [[Color/Legends|white]]. His [[Armor/Legends|helmet]] sported the colors of Blue Squadron<ref name="tcwce" /> and was detailed with blue markings.<ref name="sor" /> Because Axe was a starfighter pilot, his shoulder armor allowed him to perform quick maneuvers, and his elbow guards were attached to his forearm armor. Axe was equipped with a [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blaster]].<ref name="tcwce" />

==Behind the scenes==
Axe first appeared in "[[Storm Over Ryloth]]," the nineteenth episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which aired on [[February 27]], [[2009]]. Like all clone troopers in the series, Axe was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].<ref name="sor guide" /> Axe's biography was further expanded in the 2009 ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]''.<ref name="S1 Guide" /> In the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'', it was revealed that Axe's height is "2.08 meters."<ref name="tcwce" /> This sets up a [[Canon|continuity]] error, as the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] confirms that all clones of Jango Fett should have the height of 1.83 meters.<ref name="height" />
